category_selection_rule: Selecting visible categories or series never changes a stored numerator, denominator, support count or population.
combination_rule: Only actual ownership×degree pairs. Measures are funded_mean, unfunded_mean and paired_difference; compare funded/unfunded means separately from the signed difference.
selection_semantics: OR within a field; AND across fields; every selected value must occur in a matching released tuple. Unsupported rows do not grant a selection.
